explanation.headline: Promethazine hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list; supply traces to a plant with a Warning Letter 2026-06-02 and another plant with multiple OAI inspections and Warning Letters

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows promethazine hydrochloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
The PD-Rx label names a registered plant (FEI 1641825) whose most recent inspection was classified VAI on 2026-08-20.
The Zydus label names a registered plant (FEI 3005430968) that received a Warning Letter on 2026-06-02.
A second Zydus plant (FEI 3002984011) has a history of OAI inspections on 2011-02-03, 2014-09-05, and 2019-05-03, with Warning Letters on 2011-06-21, 2015-12-23, and 2019-10-29.
Check whether the Warning Letter at FEI 3005430968 and the OAI history at FEI 3002984011 affect current supply reliability for the Zydus NDC.
